name: Unflinching Resolve (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): A slayer that selects this talent adds his studied target bonus to his Bluff and Intimidate DCs against feint and demoralize attempts. If using Psychological Combat by Everyman Gaming, LLC, the slayer adds his studied target bonus to his psychology DC against psychological maneuvers made by his studied target instead.

Everyman Unchained: Unchained Cunning © 2015 by Everyman Gaming, LLC.; Author: Alexander Augunas.
